newsitem.title: UK: Colombia's 300 mln mark five-yr FRN due soon - DMG. [CORRECTED 11:20 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Colombia's 300 mln mark five-yr FRN due soon - DMG. [CORRECTED 11:20 GMT]

text.p: Colombia will launch a floating-rate Eurobond for up to 300 million marks early next week, joint lead manager Deutsche Morgan Grenfell in Frankfurt said on Friday.
(Corrects size of issue in title and text, from 500 million marks to 300 million marks).
The bond is expected to have a five-year maturity.
Spread talk is 130 to 150 basis points over six-month Libor. Merrill Lynch is the other lead manager.
(Corrects from "...130 to 150 basis points over German government paper.") The launch of the bond follows a three-day roadshow through Germany, Britain and Switzerland.

Colombia has issued a total of $1.08 billion in sovereign debt in the U.S., Europe and Japan this year but Finance Minister Jose Antonio Ocampo has said he had absolutely no concerns about overexposure or excessive risk.
"As a rule, we maintain a composition of risks so that, if there are losses (on the foreign exchange side) they are compensated by earnings obtained through international reserves," he said.
